title: Werbliche Kommunikation
slide_intent: Reserve the most forceful typography for brief messages so emphasis remains readable.
strategic_value: Head Extra Wide can give DB campaigns presence while Sans supports longer reading.
demonstration: Explanatory copy precedes Head Extra Wide, Head Black and Sans specimens, with qualifications for uppercase text and color.
practical_value: Use Extra Wide only for very short marketing headlines; use Sans Regular for body text and Bold for emphasis.

content_islands.name: Advertising guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the scope and color qualifications above the specimens.

content_islands.name: Type pairing
content_islands.spec: Pair headline weights at left with Sans reading weights at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy links Extra Wide to maximum presence and attention.
reference_purposes.Application: It assigns Sans Regular to body copy and Bold to highlights.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Extra Wide and all capitals are limited to short marketing headlines; departures from black require coordination with the Brand Service Desk.

ingredient.name: DB Neo Head Extra Wide
ingredient.role: Give short promotional statements strong presence.
ingredient.application: Reserve it for very short advertising headlines; use standard body families for reading.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Large expressive headlines may use Cold Black; gray is restricted to graphical type use and color departures require coordination.
